error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to The Lampster

init.title: Bluetooth connection settings
init.description: The Lampster accepts only one Bluetooth connection at a time, so the Lampster app cannot be used while Home Assistant is connected and vice-versa.

data.always_connected: Maintain Bluetooth connection at all times

data_description.always_connected: Keep the Bluetooth connection active even while The Lampster is off, so commands are more responsive. This permanently ties up one of the connection slots on your Bluetooth adapter or proxy (ESPHome Bluetooth proxies have 3 by default). If this is unchecked, you can select Submit to configure the check interval and connection hang-on time.

timing.title: Bluetooth connection timing
timing.description: While The Lampster is on, Home Assistant stays connected. These settings control what happens after it is turned off.

data_description.poll_interval: While The Lampster is off and disconnected, how often Home Assistant briefly connects to check whether it was turned on with the touch button. Shorter intervals notice it sooner but connect more often.
data_description.off_disconnect_delay: How long the connection remains active after The Lampster is turned off.

cannot_connect.title: The Lampster cannot be reached
cannot_connect.description:
Home Assistant failed to connect to The Lampster {attempts} times in a row. The last error was: {error}

Check that the Lampster app is not connected to The Lampster, that The Lampster is plugged in, and that it is within range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy. This notice clears itself once a connection succeeds.

no_connection_slot.title: No free Bluetooth connection slot for The Lampster
no_connection_slot.description:
Home Assistant failed to connect to The Lampster {attempts} times in a row because every connection slot on the Bluetooth adapters and proxies that can reach it is in use. The last error was: {error}

Free a slot by disconnecting another Bluetooth device, turn off "Maintain Bluetooth connection at all times" for devices that do not need it, or add another Bluetooth proxy near The Lampster. This notice clears itself once a connection succeeds.

not_heard.title: The Lampster cannot be found
not_heard.description:
Home Assistant has not heard The Lampster for several minutes and is not connected to it. The Lampster stops sending Bluetooth signals while something else is connected to it, and it can also stop responding until it is power-cycled.

Try these in order:
1. Close the Lampster app.
2. Unplug The Lampster for about 10 seconds, then plug it back in.
3. Check the nearest Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
4. Connect once with the Lampster app, then repeat starting at step 1.

This notice clears itself as soon as Home Assistant hears The Lampster again.
